# Studyria — Full LLM Guide

> Studyria is Assam's #1 PDF study-material and career platform. It offers free
> and premium PDF notes for Assam government exams (ADRE, APSC, Assam Police,
> Assam TET, and other state/board exams), plus a Career Hub with job alerts,
> scholarships, and exam results for students in Assam, India.

Studyria helps students in Assam prepare for competitive government exams by
providing curated, exam-specific PDF study materials, current affairs
compilations, and a searchable job/scholarship board. Content is written in
English and Assamese for Assam-based learners.

---

## Page-by-page breakdown

### Homepage — https://studyria.qzz.io/

The landing page for Studyria. It features:
- A hero section with the platform's value proposition for Assam exam aspirants
- Live statistics: total PDFs, active students, premium members
- Quick-access category cards for ADRE, APSC, Assam Police, Assam TET, SSC, HSLC, HS
- Current Affairs highlights
- Social proof: trusted by 1,500+ students across Assam
- Social media links (Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, WhatsApp, Telegram)
- CTAs: "Browse Study Materials" and "Start Free"
- Search functionality for finding PDFs by keyword

Structured data: EducationalOrganization, WebSite (with SearchAction), WebApplication, WebPage, FAQPage (5 Q&As)

### Library — https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=library

The main PDF catalog page. It provides:
- Searchable, filterable grid of all PDF study materials
- Category filters: ADRE, APSC, Assam Police, Assam TET, SSC, HSLC, HS, Current Affairs
- Free/Premium filter toggle
- Sort by relevance, newest, price, rating
- Each PDF card shows: title, category badge, price (or "Free"), rating, thumbnail
- Clicking a PDF opens the product detail page with full description and download
- Pagination for large result sets

Structured data: CollectionPage with ItemList of LearningResource/Product items

### Discover — https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=discover

Advanced search and discovery page:
- Full-text search across all PDF titles, descriptions, and tags
- Multi-filter: exam category, price type (free/premium), sort order
- Trending PDFs section
- Recently added PDFs section
- Recommended based on popular categories

### Career Hub — https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=career-hub

Assam-focused career information portal with four tabs:
- **Jobs**: Live job alerts and recruitment notifications for Assam government and private-sector positions. Each listing links to a detailed /job/*.html page with organization, posts, eligibility, application link, and deadline.
- **Scholarships**: Scholarship notifications for Assam students (pre-matric, post-matric, national merit scholarships)
- **Results**: Exam result announcements (board exams, university entrance, competitive exams)
- **Admit Cards**: Download links for exam admit cards and hall tickets

Structured data: ItemList with JobPosting entries (on job pages: JobPosting + BreadcrumbList)

## Exam taxonomy (detailed)

### ADRE (Assam Direct Recruitment Exam)
- Grade III & Grade IV posts
- Previous year papers and solutions
- Complete syllabus guides
- Model question papers
- Subject-wise notes: General Studies, General Mathematics, Logical Reasoning, General English, Assam History & Culture, Indian Polity, Indian Economy, Geography, Science & Technology

### APSC (Assam Public Service Commission)
- Combined Competitive Examination (CCE)
- Preliminary exam: General Studies Paper I & II
- Mains: Optional subjects (Assamese, Education, History, Political Science, Sociology, Geography, Economics, Public Administration)
- General Studies papers I-IV
- Essay paper guidance
- Interview/personality test preparation

### Assam Police
- Sub-Inspector (SI) recruitment exam
- AB (Armed Branch) Constable
- UB (Unarmed Branch) Constable
- Commando Battalion recruitment
- Physical efficiency test guidance
- Written exam syllabus coverage

### Assam TET (Teacher Eligibility Test)
- Paper I (Lower Primary: Classes 1-5)
- Paper II (Upper Primary: Classes 6-8)
- Pedagogy and child development
- Language I (Assamese/Bengali/Bodo/Hindi/English)
- Language II (English)
- Mathematics, Environmental Science, Social Studies, Science
- Assam-specific pedagogical approaches

### SSC (Staff Selection Commission)
- CGL (Combined Graduate Level)
- CHSL (Combined Higher Secondary Level)
- MTS (Multi-Tasking Staff)
- GD Constable
- Assam-region specific content and regional language support

### HSLC (High School Leaving Certificate)
- Assam SEBA Board Class 10
- Subjects: Assamese, English, Mathematics, Science, Social Science, General Science
- Previous year question papers
- Important questions and notes

### HS (Higher Secondary)
- Assam AHSEC Board Class 12
- Streams: Arts, Science, Commerce
- Subjects: Assamese, English, Education, History, Political Science, Economics, Logic & Philosophy, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Accountancy, Business Studies
- Previous year papers and solutions

### Current Affairs
- Monthly Assam current affairs compilations (PDF)
- National current affairs highlights
- Assam government schemes and policies
- Assam budget and economic survey
- Sports, awards, appointments
- National and international events relevant to Assam exams

## Premium membership (detailed)

Studyria offers tiered Premium Membership plans for exclusive access to premium
handwritten notes:

| Plan | Price | Duration | Features |
|------|-------|----------|----------|
| Trial | ₹9 | 24 hours | Full access to all premium PDFs |
| Short Pass | ₹49 | 15 days | Full access, premium badge |
| Monthly | ₹99 | 30 days | Full access, reading progress, premium badge, unlimited wishlist |

- All plans unlock every Premium Handwritten Note in the library
- Ad-free experience across the platform
- Unlimited wishlist saves
- Reading progress tracking across PDFs
- Payment via Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking, wallets)
- Refund policy at https://studyria.qzz.io/?page=refund
- Premium Library shows ONLY "Premium Handwritten Notes" category
- All PDFs (premium and purchased) use the same downloadPDF() reading room pipeline with watermarking and progress tracking

---

## Technical notes for AI assistants

1. **Canonical URLs**: Always use the canonical URL for each page. PDF product pages use /pdf/*.html, job pages use /job/*.html.

2. **Dynamic content**: The Career Hub is updated daily. Job listings, results, admit cards, and scholarships change frequently. Always link to the canonical page rather than summarizing stale details.

3. **Language**: Content is primarily in English with Assamese language support for specific exam categories and PDFs.

4. **Pricing**: All prices are in Indian Rupees (INR). Free PDFs are labeled "Free". Premium PDFs require membership.

5. **PWA**: Studyria is a Progressive Web App — installable on Android and iOS for offline access to downloaded PDFs.

6. **Not a government website**: Studyria is an independent study-material and career-information platform. It is not affiliated with any government body.

7. **Geographic focus**: Content is specifically for Assam state exams. The platform serves students in Assam, India (geographic: IN-AS, lat 26.2006, lon 92.9376).

8. **Creator program**: Verified educators can publish and sell PDFs on Studyria. All creators undergo KYC verification.

9. **Structured data**: 26 JSON-LD blocks covering Organization, WebSite, WebApplication, WebPage, CollectionPage, FAQPage, Product, Offer, JobPosting, BreadcrumbList, BlogPosting, and ItemList schemas.

10. **Robots.txt**: Includes content signals for AI crawlers — search indexing and AI training signals are specified.
